quote: We apply LMTransplant to various deep learning tasks, including text classification, question answering and named entity recognition (NER), and compare its performance with existing data augmentation methods.
outputs: The paper generates augmented text variants for low-resource training scenarios, focusing on preserving core attributes (e.g., sentiment, intent) while increasing lexical and semantic diversity.

quote: For intrinsic evaluation, we adopt two widely employed metrics to assess the quality of the augmented samples: Distinct-N measures the lexical diversity . It is defined as the ratio of unique n-grams across all generated texts and their corresponding seeds... Semantic Variability measures how well the generated text extends the semantics of the seed texts.
